provenance: Original generated artwork; owner preferred candidate ('That's better'). Final masked launcher appearance and physical acceptance pending.
original_design: GridMates fox in explorer hat holding parchment grid map, golden compass marker, golden wooden frame and forest-green surround.
processing: Original RGB retained unchanged. Find edge-connected exterior pixels whose maximum RGB channel is <=45 using 4-connected flood fill; set their alpha to zero. Legacy: composite over #032C14, Lanczos resize to 192x192 RGB. Adaptive: Lanczos resize transparent artwork to 232x232 RGBA and center at (100,100) on transparent 432x432 canvas (58dp of 108dp). No redrawing, recoloring of interior art, or baked text. Simulated round-mask preview checked locally; Android masks vary.
